from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
import argparse,hashlib,json,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument("--packet",type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();R=a.packet
def j(path):return json.loads((R/path).read_bytes())
def api(path):
 x=j(path)
 while not any(k in x for k in ("workflow_runs","jobs","artifacts")):
  if "structuredContent" in x:x=x["structuredContent"]
  elif isinstance(x.get("content"),str):x=json.loads(x["content"])
  else:raise ValueError("unsupported API wrapper")
 return x
def identity(b):return {"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"git_blob":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()}
runs=api("original/run-list.original.json");assert runs["total_count"]==len(runs["workflow_runs"])==19
jobs=[]
for run in runs["workflow_runs"]:
 data=api("original/run-%d-jobs.original.json"%run["id"])
 assert data["total_count"]==len(data["jobs"])<=100
 assert all(x["head_sha"]=="67cc5c28c4adf82f6ef97c34a18b8b13f3ac27ed" and x["run_id"]==run["id"] for x in data["jobs"])
 jobs.extend(data["jobs"])
counts=dict(sorted(Counter(x["conclusion"] or x["status"] for x in jobs).items()))
assert len(jobs)==len({x["id"] for x in jobs})==85
assert counts=={"cancelled":9,"failure":2,"in_progress":4,"queued":10,"skipped":5,"success":55}
failures=sorted(x["id"] for x in jobs if x["conclusion"]=="failure")
assert failures==[127679861307,127679861687]
blocking=next(x for x in runs["workflow_runs"] if x["id"]==42123581385);assert blocking["status"]=="queued" and blocking["conclusion"] is None
source_matches=[]
for row in j("source-map.json"):
 b=(R/"source"/row["path"]).read_bytes()
 fetched=j("source-GET/"+row["git_blob"]+".json")["structuredContent"]["content"].encode()
 assert b==fetched and identity(b)=={k:row[k] for k in ("bytes","git_blob","sha256")}
 source_matches.append(row["path"])
assert len(source_matches)==21
proto=(R/"primary/spawn.proto").read_bytes();pg=j("primary/spawn.proto.GET-original.json")
assert pg["structuredContent"]["content"].encode()==proto
primary_url=pg["structuredContent"]["url"];assert "9.3.0" in primary_url and "spawn.proto" in primary_url
compact=j("derived/compact-summary.json");core=j("derived/compact-core-test-runners.json")
actual=[s for s in core if s["args"][0].replace("\\","/").split("/")[-1]=="tw.exe"]
xml=[s for s in core if s["args"][0].replace("\\","/").split("/")[-1]=="xml.exe"]
assert len(core)==42 and len(actual)==len(xml)==21
assert all(x["runner"]=="local" and x["cache_hit"] is False and x["timeout_millis"]==900000 for x in actual)
assert Counter(x["exit_code"] for x in actual)=={0:15,1:6}
assert all(x["exit_code"]==0 and x["timeout_millis"]==0 for x in xml)
def shard(s):return int({v["name"]:v["value"] for v in s["env_vars"]}["TEST_SHARD_INDEX"])+1
aa=defaultdict(list);xx=defaultdict(list)
for s in actual:aa[shard(s)].append(s)
for s in xml:xx[shard(s)].append(s)
assert set(aa)==set(range(1,17)) and {k:len(v) for k,v in aa.items() if len(v)>1}=={4:2,6:2,7:3,13:2}
base=R/"artifacts/windows-shard4-original/failed-test-logs/invocation-jmk8w12b/targets/0000"
rx=re.compile(r"^test (.+) \.\.\. (ok|FAILED|ignored)(?:,.*)?$",re.M)
mismatches=[];final_rows=[];attempts=[];failnames=set()
for n in range(1,17):
 first_output=None
 for index,(s,x) in enumerate(zip(aa[n],xx[n]),1):
  assert len(aa[n])==len(xx[n]) and s["sequence"]<x["sequence"]
  suffix=("test_attempts/attempt_%d.log"%index) if index<len(aa[n]) else "test.log"
  lp=base/("shard_%d_of_16"%n)/suffix;xp=lp.with_suffix(".xml")
  log=lp.read_bytes().decode().replace("\r\n","\n");xb=xp.read_bytes();xt=ET.fromstring(xb)
  cases=rx.findall(log); assert cases
  assert rx.findall(xt.find(".//system-out").text)==cases
  assert len(xt.findall(".//testcase"))==1
  assert bool(xt.findall(".//error"))==bool(s["exit_code"])
  assert int(x["args"][-1])==s["exit_code"] and xt.find(".//testcase").get("time")==x["args"][-2]
  out=next(z for z in x["outputs"] if z.get("path","").endswith("/test.xml"))
  if first_output is None:first_output=out
  actual_hash=hashlib.sha256(xb).hexdigest();match=out["digest"]["hash"]==actual_hash
  if not match:
   assert out["entry_id"]==first_output["entry_id"] and out["digest"]==first_output["digest"]
   first_x=base/("shard_%d_of_16"%n)/"test_attempts/attempt_1.xml"
   assert hashlib.sha256(first_x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==out["digest"]["hash"]
   mismatches.append({"shard":n,"attempt":index,"reused_first_file_entry_id":out["entry_id"],"compact_digest":out["digest"]["hash"],"archived_later_xml_sha256":actual_hash})
  failed=[name for name,status in cases if status=="FAILED"]
  assert bool(failed)==bool(s["exit_code"])
  if n in [4,6,13] and index==1:
   assert "program not found" in log.lower() and "codex-windows-sandbox-setup.exe" in log
  if n==7:
   assert len(failed)==3 and "apply deny-read ACLs" in log
  attempts.append({"shard":n,"attempt":index,"final":index==len(aa[n]),"exit":s["exit_code"],"xml_digest_matches":match,"failed_names":failed})
  if index==len(aa[n]):final_rows.extend(cases);failnames.update(failed)
assert [(x["shard"],x["attempt"]) for x in mismatches]==[(4,2),(6,2),(7,2),(7,3),(13,2)]
assert Counter(status for name,status in final_rows)=={"ok":1038,"ignored":90,"FAILED":3}
unique={}
for name,status in final_rows:
 assert name not in unique or unique[name]==status
 unique[name]=status
assert Counter(unique.values())=={"ok":1030,"ignored":72,"FAILED":3}
all_tests=j("derived/compact-all-test-runners.json")
pty=[s for s in all_tests if s["target_label"]=="//codex-rs/utils/pty:pty-unit-tests"]
assert len(pty)==2 and all(s["cache_hit"] is True and s["runner"]=="remote cache hit" for s in pty)
console=(R/"original/job-127679861687.original.log").read_bytes().decode()
assert re.search(r"//codex-rs/utils/pty:pty-unit-tests[ \t]+\(cached\) PASSED",console)
assert "Executed 51 out of 149 tests: 115 tests pass, 1 fails locally, and 33 were skipped." in console
cargo=next(x for x in jobs if x["id"]==127679861307)
assert [x["name"] for x in cargo["steps"] if x["conclusion"]=="failure"]==["Run cargo-deny"]
errors=[]
for name in ["original/cargo-deny-log-tool-error-01.json","original/cargo-deny-log-tool-error-02.json"]:
 raw=(R/name).read_bytes();error=json.loads(raw);assert error["isError"] and "Transport closed" in json.dumps(error)
 errors.append({"path":name,"identity":identity(raw),"classification":"EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL_TRANSPORT_ERROR_NOT_PRODUCT_DIAGNOSIS"})
art=api("original/blocking-run-artifacts.original.json")
assert art["total_count"]==len(art["artifacts"])==6
assert not any("deny" in x["name"].lower() for x in art["artifacts"])
report={"schema":"main85-independent-denominator-and-custody-semantics-v1","result":"PASS_FIXED_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_WITH_EXPLICIT_LIMITS",
 "API":{"runs":19,"run_counts":dict(sorted(Counter(x["conclusion"] or x["status"] for x in runs["workflow_runs"]).items())),"unique_jobs":85,"job_counts":counts,"failure_job_ids":failures,"blocking_run_queued_despite_two_real_failed_jobs":True},
 "fixed_sources":{"all_21_original_GET_bodies_equal":True,"decoder_primary_url":primary_url,"proto_identity":identity(proto),"decoder_identity":identity((R/"decode_compact.py").read_bytes()),"verifier_identity":identity((R/"verify_packet.py").read_bytes())},

官方artifact47成员、Core42文件、PTY2文件及两manifest范围成立；它不是全部149target的完整日志集。
Windows最终三失败属于Core managed ACL/setup/protected metadata路径，与既有B11宿主outside-delete原断言分开；原首attempt的helper program-not-found不能外推成hard-link实际逃逸。

cargo-deny实际API步骤失败与两次Transport closed原错误分别保留；实际checkout、原退出码、advisory/license/dependency原因仍UNKNOWN。
本审阅只核固定证据；不改变原23项exit/status、不签发主产品全部required通过，也未修复上述两项原失败。
